newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: AIR COMPANIES CARRY MORE PASSENGERS, FREIGHT.
newsitem.headline: AIR COMPANIES CARRY MORE PASSENGERS, FREIGHT.

text.p: Lithuanian airline companies carried 88,800 passengers in the first five months of the year, a 7.6 percent increase over the same period in 1996, the country's statistics department said on Monday.
The statement also said that 82,400 passengers of the total were transported by scheduled flights.

The statistics department also said that the country's airline companies carried 915,000 tonnes of freight, luggage and mail in the first five months of the year, a 34.2 percent increase over the same period in 1996.
The statistics department also said that 7,850 aircraft arrived and departed from the country's airports in January - May of 1997, an increase of 14.9 percent compared to the same period in 1996.
The statement said that 7,422 of the flights were international.
